Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Zoya - 12 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Kavita - 41 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Vikram - 37 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Zoya stands in the living room. Ishaan, Kavita and Vikram stand near her.]

Vikram: "Today feels like a good day."

[Zoya puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Zoya: "Yes, all right."

[Ishaan eats his breakfast at the table.]

Zoya: "I knew it!"

[Ishaan munches on an apple.]

Zoya: "That was fun!"

[Ishaan opens the door and goes out.]

Zoya: "Mom, look at this."

[Ishaan opens the window.]

Vikram: "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Kavita, Zoya and Vikram stand near him.]

Zoya: "Dad, look over here."

[Ishaan jumps with joy.]

Zoya (gently): "Exactly right."

[Ishaan tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Ishaan (happily): "Yes, of course."

[Ishaan climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Zoya (happily): "Exactly right."

[Ishaan peeks out from behind the door.]

Ishaan: "That's easy."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Night

Vikram: "What a nice place."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Ishaan: "Let's see."

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Kavita: "That was such a fun day!"
